description: Use when enumerating an AWS environment during an authorized cloud assessment, bug bounty engagement, or lab exercise. Covers identity and account context with sts get-caller-identity, IAM users, roles, groups and policies, EC2 instances, security groups and AMIs, S3 buckets, Lambda functions, Secrets Manager, RDS, and CloudTrail configuration using aws-cli 2.22 and Python 3.12. Use when you hold AWS credentials for a test account and need to map what the principal can reach, or when the scope permits unauthenticated checks of public buckets and resources.
